ns2:course.label: Health and Wellness in Life Sciences
ns2:course.description: Grand Challenge Learning course in the Health & Wellness pathway. Introduces students to the fundamentals of life sciences with an emphasis on health & wellness and experiential learning through projects, design-based thinking, community-engaged scholarship, or field trips. Topics vary by section.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Freshman or Sophomore class standing.
ns2:course.sectionDegreeAttributes: Grand Challenge-Health/Well, and Nat Sci & Tech - Life Sciences course.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: This course is intended for first and second year students.
